name: order_flow_imbalance_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when FII/DII algorithmic TWAP orders are systematically absorbing sell-side inventory, consecutive 5-second bars show elevated positive signed volume (close > open) even as market makers reprice only incrementally — the index range-bounds while buying accumulates. This signed-volume/price divergence — measurable as a strongly positive 1-minute cumulative OFI ratio against a flat or negative 1-minute price return — persists for 30-90 seconds until the available sell inventory depletes and NIFTY prints a sharp 10-20 spot point directional break. At 5-second resolution we can enter during the accumulation phase before price responds, capturing the first 15-20 spot points of the breakout. The reverse pattern (consecutive bearish bars despite flat price) signals systematic distribution by institutional sellers before a decline.

indicators.name: signed_vol_ratio
indicators.formula: sign(close - open) * 1.0 — normalized per-bar flow direction
indicators.purpose: Per-bar order flow proxy: +1 for bullish bar (close>open), -1 for bearish bar, 0 for doji. Approximates Lee-Ready trade classification using OHLCV. At 5-second resolution each bar direction cleanly reflects short-term net buying pressure — doji bars are excluded to avoid false neutrals from two-sided activity.

indicators.name: ofi_fast
indicators.purpose: 1-minute cumulative OFI (12 bars × 5s). Original used EMA(5) over 1-min bars (5-min context). Compressed to 12-bar rolling sum because we trade the fast divergence signal in the 15-120s window — OFI from >1 minute ago has already repriced or been absorbed. 12 bars matches our time-stop (24 bars) with a 2:1 lookback-to-hold ratio.

indicators.name: ofi_slow
indicators.purpose: 5-minute context OFI (60 bars × 5s). Maps to original's EMA(15) at 1-min bars (15-min context), but halved to 5 minutes because institutional directional flow on NIFTY index resolves faster than on individual stocks. Used only as a context filter to avoid fighting sustained institutional flow — not the primary entry signal.

indicators.name: price_change_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute price return, same window as ofi_fast. Detects divergence: when ofi_fast is strongly positive but price_change_12 is flat/negative, latent buying pressure has accumulated but price has not yet responded — the key alpha signal from the original strategy.

conditions: ofi_fast > ofi_threshold (1-min signed-volume ratio exceeds bullish threshold)
bull_divergence: ofi_fast > threshold AND price_change_12 <= 0 (flow bullish, price flat/down — latent buying)
OR bull_trend: ofi_fast > threshold AND ofi_slow > 0 AND price_change_12 > 0 (flow and price aligned, sustained flow confirms)
vix < 22 (avoid microstructure noise in high-volatility regimes)
buy_ce.confirmation: Either divergence or trend signal fires; cannot fire simultaneously with buy_pe

conditions: ofi_fast < -ofi_threshold (1-min signed-volume ratio exceeds bearish threshold)
bear_divergence: ofi_fast < -threshold AND price_change_12 >= 0 (flow bearish, price flat/up — latent selling)
OR bear_trend: ofi_fast < -threshold AND ofi_slow < 0 AND price_change_12 < 0 (flow and price aligned, sustained flow confirms)
buy_pe.confirmation: Either divergence or trend signal fires; cannot fire simultaneously with buy_ce

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If a genuine OFI accumulation is building, NIFTY should not retrace 10+ spot points against the signal within 120 seconds — a retrace of that magnitude means inventory absorption completed at a different price level and the thesis is broken.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points (~16 NIFTY spot pts). OFI-driven inventory exhaustion on NIFTY typically resolves in a 15-25 spot point directional break within 2 minutes; 16 pts captures ~65% of the expected move (1:1.6 R:R) while leaving room for partial fills at the tighter stop.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 22 — above 22, tail-risk hedging dominates NIFTY microstructure and signed-volume OFI becomes unreliable as market makers widen and stop absorbing flow directionally
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST — skip first 5 min (pre-open noise) and last 10 min (EOD position squaring)
filters.volume_filter: none — signed direction ratio is self-normalizing, does not depend on absolute volume levels
filters.trend_filter: ofi_slow direction aligns or is neutral for entry; conflict between ofi_fast and ofi_slow suppressed via divergence-only mode
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — OHLCV signed-volume OFI proxy is less precise than tick-level Lee-Ready. Signal strength depends on 5-second bars cleanly reflecting net order flow, most reliable during active institutional TWAP windows (10:00-11:30, 13:30-15:00 IST).

adaptation_notes: Original requires tick-level trade data with Lee-Ready buy/sell classification (not available in the 5s OHLCV pipeline). Adapted to OHLCV signed-volume proxy: sign(close-open) per bar, summed over a rolling window — preserves the core OFI accumulation signal without per-trade classification. Applied to NIFTY index directly rather than constituent stocks; the index naturally aggregates all component order flows. Original's session-cumulative OFI replaced by 1-min rolling OFI because session-level accumulation is too slow for 15-120s holds. Original's EMA(5)/EMA(15) on 1-min bars (5/15 min context) compressed to 12/60-bar rolling sums (1/5 min at 5s) to match the faster hold time. The key alpha signal — OFI positive while price flat — is preserved exactly as the divergence entry condition.
weaknesses: Signed-volume proxy misclassifies doji bars (close ≈ open with high activity) — these show as 0 OFI but may have significant two-sided institutional activity

NIFTY 5-second volume is pre-aggregated across all constituent trades; the signed direction from a single bar may not reflect the dominant institutional flow when large opposing orders partially cancel
Divergence signal frequency may be low on trend days where price and flow move together from the start, reducing trade count
